When we turn raise-lower switch

 measured the voltage by connect voltammeter at point (1G) and (10H) at

Make jumper between point (1),(2) to force the gate 100.3%

Measured the voltage by connect voltammeter at 
 point (1G) and (10H) at calibrator set. It must be (-0.3 volt), if it is not
